outlook.statement: The hospitality sector is expected to remain stable in FY2026-27, supported by domestic leisure travel and MICE demand, with room rates likely to remain firm. Industry revenues projected to grow by ~7–9% Y-o-Y. Near-term performance may be affected by geopolitical developments in West Asia and related aviation disruptions. Over the medium to long term, structural drivers including rising discretionary spending, expanding middle class, and continued business travel are expected to support industry growth.
outlook.period: FY2026-27 and medium to long term

outlook.statement: Business recovery is likely to be driven by domestic leisure tourism, staycations, domestic business travel and limited international travel.
The hospitality sector is expected to remain stable in FY2026-27, supported by domestic leisure travel and MICE demand, with room rates likely to remain firm.
According to ICRA, industry revenues are projected to grow by ~7–9% Y-o-Y in FY2026-27, with occupancy and ARR continuing to improve.

Near-term performance may be affected by geopolitical developments in West Asia and related aviation disruptions, which could temporarily impact select international and corporate travel corridors while keeping fuel, logistics and utility costs elevated.
Over the medium to long term, structural drivers including rising discretionary spending, an expanding middle class and continued business travel are expected to support industry growth.
India's rising prominence in the global economy is expected to contribute to sectoral growth by attracting higher inflows of foreign visitors.
India's economic outlook for FY 2026-27 remains strong, with real GDP growth projected at approximately 6.9% and CPI inflation at around 4.6%.
Global growth is expected to remain at 3.1% in CY 2026, below the IMF's pre-pandemic long-term average of 3.7%.
OECD projects global growth to moderate to 2.9% in 2026 from ~3.2% in 2025.
World merchandise trade volume growth expected to moderate to 1.9% in 2026 from 4.6% in 2025, before improving to 2.6% in 2027.

Complete product portfolio across all life-stage segments, differentiated product proposition and initiatives to augment member spends at resorts to generate robust performance
